008package paint.viewer.override.square_override;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.TextFiles;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
012import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
013
014import java.io.IOException;
015import java.nio.file.*;
016import java.time.LocalDateTime;
017import java.util.*;
018
019import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.SQUARE_NUMBER;
020import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.CELL_ID;
021import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.TIME_STAMP;
022import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.EXPERIMENT_NAME;
023import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.RECORDING_NAME;
024
025
026/**
027 * Writes and maintains per-square cell assignment overrides for the PAINT Viewer.
028 * <p>
029 * Overrides are stored in {@code <project>/Viewer/Square Override.csv}. Each row identifies
030 * a square using {@code (experimentName, recordingName, squareNumber)} and provides an
031 * overridden {@code cellId} plus a timestamp. This class performs disk I/O only; it does
032 * not apply overrides to in-memory {@link paint.shared.objects.Square} instances.
033 */
034public class WriteSquareOverride {
035
036    /** Path to: Viewer/Square Override.csv */
037    private final Path csvFilePath;
038
039    /** CSV header columns (must match the persisted file exactly) */
040    private static final String[] HEADER = {
041            EXPERIMENT_NAME,
042            RECORDING_NAME,
043            SQUARE_NUMBER,
044            CELL_ID,
045            TIME_STAMP
046    };
047
048    /**
049     * Builds a composite key for a (experiment, recording, square) combination.
050     */
051    private static String key(String exp, String rec, int square) {
052        return exp + "§" + rec + "§" + square;
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * Constructs a new writer for the given project and ensures the {@code Viewer/} directory exists.
057     *
058     * @param projectPath root path of the project
059     */
060    public WriteSquareOverride(Path projectPath) {
061        Path viewerPath = projectPath.resolve("Viewer");
062        try {
063            Files.createDirectories(viewerPath);
064        } catch (IOException e) {
065            // Don't swallow: a failure here makes the later CSV write fail with a
066            // confusing "no such directory" error. Log it so the real cause is clear.
067            PaintLogger.error("Could not create Viewer directory: " + viewerPath, e);
068        }
069
070        this.csvFilePath = viewerPath.resolve("Square Override.csv");
071    }
072
073    /**
074     * Writes or updates the cell assignment overrides for selected squares.
075     * <p>
076     * The provided {@code assignments} are merged into any existing overrides:
077     * <ul>
078     *     <li>If {@code cellId == 0}, the override row for that square is removed.</li>
079     *     <li>Otherwise, the square’s row is added or replaced with the new cellId and timestamp.</li>
080     * </ul>
081     *
082     * @param recordingEntry the recording entry to update
083     * @param assignments    map of squareNumber → cellId
084     */
085    public void writeSquareOverridesToFile(RecordingEntry recordingEntry, Map<Integer, Integer> assignments) {
086        String experiment = recordingEntry.getExperimentName();
087        String recording  = recordingEntry.getRecordingName();
088        String timestamp  = LocalDateTime.now().toString();
089
090        // Load existing overrides into a map
091        Map<String, String> map = loadExistingRows();
092
093        // Update or remove entries
094        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> e : assignments.entrySet()) {
095            int square = e.getKey();
096            int cellId = e.getValue();
097
098            String k = key(experiment, recording, square);
099
100            if (cellId == 0) {
101                // Remove override for this square
102                map.remove(k);
103            } else {
104                // Update override (replace existing row for this square)
105                String line = experiment + "," +
106                        recording  + "," +
107                        square     + "," +
108                        cellId     + "," +
109                        timestamp;
110
111                map.put(k, line);
112            }
113        }
114
115        writeAll(map);
116    }
117
118    // ========================================================================
119    //   LOAD EXISTING ROWS FROM CSV
120    // ========================================================================
121
122    /**
123     * Reads the CSV file into a map keyed by (experiment, recording, square).
124     * <p>
125     * If the file is missing, an empty map is returned. If the header is malformed,
126     * a warning is logged and an empty map is returned (caller will rewrite a clean file).
127     *
128     * @return a map of compositeKey → CSV row
129     */
130    private Map<String, String> loadExistingRows() {
131        Map<String, String> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
132
133        if (!Files.exists(csvFilePath)) {
134            return map;
135        }
136
137        try {
138            List<String> lines = TextFiles.readAllLines(csvFilePath);
139            if (lines.isEmpty()) {
140                return map;
141            }
142
143            String expectedHeader = String.join(",", HEADER);
144
145            // Validate header
146            if (!lines.get(0).equalsIgnoreCase(expectedHeader)) {
147                PaintLogger.warnf("Invalid Square Override.csv header. Rebuilding.");
148                return map;  // Start fresh
149            }
150
151            // Parse each row
152            for (int i = 1; i < lines.size(); i++) {
153                String line = lines.get(i).trim();
154                if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
155
156                String[] p = line.split(",", 5);
157                if (p.length < 4) continue;
158
159                String exp = p[0];
160                String rec = p[1];
161                int square = Integer.parseInt(p[2]);
162
163                map.put(key(exp, rec, square), line);
164            }
165
166        } catch (Exception e) {
167            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed reading Square Override.csv: %s", e.getMessage());
168        }
169
170        return map;
171    }
172
173    // ========================================================================
174    //   SAVE ALL ROWS BACK TO DISK
175    // ========================================================================
176
177    /**
178     * Writes all overrides back to the CSV file using an atomic file replace.
179     *
180     * @param map compositeKey → CSV row
181     */
182    private void writeAll(Map<String, String> map) {
183
184        String header = String.join(",", HEADER);
185
186        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
187        out.add(header);
188        out.addAll(map.values());
189
190        Path tmp = csvFilePath.resolveSibling(csvFilePath.getFileName() + ".tmp");
191
192        try {
193            Files.write(tmp, out);
194            Files.move(tmp, csvFilePath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
195        } catch (IOException e) {
196            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed writing Square Override.csv: %s", e.getMessage());
197        }
198    }
199
200    // ========================================================================
201    //   QUERY FOR EXISTING OVERRIDES
202    // ========================================================================
203
204    /**
205     * Checks whether this recording already has override entries in {@code Square Override.csv}.
206     *
207     * @param re recording entry
208     * @return true if at least one override exists for this recording
209     */
210    public boolean hasOverridesFor(RecordingEntry re) {
211        String prefix = re.getExperimentName() + "," + re.getRecordingName() + ",";
212        try {
213            if (!Files.exists(csvFilePath)) {
214                return false;
215            }
216            return TextFiles.readAllLines(csvFilePath)
217                        .stream()
218                        .anyMatch(line -> line.startsWith(prefix));
219        } catch (IOException e) {
220            PaintLogger.warnf("Error checking square overrides: %s", e.getMessage());
221            return false;
222        }
223    }
224
225    // ========================================================================
226    //   MERGE / REPLACE LOGIC
227    // ========================================================================
228
229    /**
230     * Merges new assignments into existing ones without removing other squares
231     * (except where {@code cellId == 0}, which removes that square’s override row).
232     */
233    public void mergeSquareOverrides(RecordingEntry re, Map<Integer, Integer> newAssignments) {
234        writeSquareOverridesToFile(re, newAssignments);
235    }
236
237    /**
238     * Replaces all existing assignments for the given recording with only the
239     * provided assignments.
240     *
241     * @param re             the recording entry whose overrides should be replaced
242     * @param newAssignments map of squareNumber → cellId
243     */
244    public void replaceSquareOverrides(
245            RecordingEntry re,
246            Map<Integer, Integer> newAssignments
247    ) {
248        String prefix = re.getExperimentName() + "," + re.getRecordingName() + ",";
249
250        try {
251            List<String> lines = Files.exists(csvFilePath)
252                    ? TextFiles.readAllLines(csvFilePath)
253                    : new ArrayList<>();
254
255            String header = String.join(",", HEADER);
256
257            // Validate header
258            if (lines.isEmpty() || !lines.get(0).equals(header)) {
259                lines.clear();
260                lines.add(header);
261            }
262
263            // Remove all old rows for this recording
264            lines.removeIf(line -> line.startsWith(prefix) && !line.equals(header));
265
266            // Add new entries
267            String experimentName = re.getExperimentName();
268            String recordingName  = re.getRecordingName();
269            String timestamp      = LocalDateTime.now().toString();
270
271            for (Map.Entry<Integer,Integer> entry : newAssignments.entrySet()) {
272                int cellId = entry.getValue();
273                if (cellId == 0) {
274                    continue;
275                }
276
277                int squareNumber = entry.getKey();
278
279                String newLine =
280                        experimentName + "," +
281                                recordingName  + "," +
282                                squareNumber   + "," +
283                                cellId         + "," +
284                                timestamp;
285
286                lines.add(newLine);
287            }
288
289            // Atomic write
290            Path tmp = csvFilePath.resolveSibling("Square Override.tmp");
291            Files.write(tmp, lines);
292            Files.move(tmp, csvFilePath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
293        } catch (IOException ex) {
294            PaintLogger.errorf("Error writing square overrides: %s", ex.getMessage());
295        }
296    }
297}
